description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to amend the Gaz. Ex. No. 2049/16 adding Electrical apparatus etc.
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - an amendment to the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No. 18 of 2011. It contains an order made under Section 3 of the Act that modifies the schedule of exempted articles, which constitutes a regulatory change. While it mentions Eran Wickramaratne as Acting Minister of Finance, this is incidental to the main purpose of publishing a legal/regulatory amendment rather than being primarily about government personnel or organizational structure. The content focuses on modifying customs/excise regulations rather than government administration.
